Question
========

Betrachten Sie den Datensatz `mtcars` (die ersten fünf Zeilen): 

```{r}
mtcars %>% 
  slice(1:5)
```

[Quelle](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/doc/datasets/mtcars.html)


Gesucht ist die korrekte Syntax, um folgenden zusammengefassten Datensatz zu erhalten:


```{r}
mtcars %>% 
  select(1:2, hp) %>% 
  group_by(cyl, schluckspecht = mpg > 20) %>% 
  summarise(ps_mw = round(mean(hp)),
            ps_sd = round(sd(hp)))
```


Vier Syntaxvarianten stehen zur Auswahl:

**A**
```
mtcars %>% 
  select(1:2, hp) %>% 
  group_by(cyl, mpg > 20) %>% 
  summarise(ps_mw = round(mean(hp)),
            ps_sd = round(sd(hp)))
```



**B**
```
mtcars %>% 
  select(1:2, hp) %>% 
  group_by(cyl, mpg > 20) %>% 
  summarise(ps_mw = mean(hp)),
            ps_sd = sd(hp)))
```



**C**
```
mtcars %>% 
  select(1:2, hp) %>% 
  group_by(cyl, schluckspecht = mpg > 20) %>% 
  summarise(ps_mw = round(mean(hp)),
            ps_sd = round(sd(hp)))
```


**D**
```
mtcars %>% 
  select(1:2, hp) %>% 
  group_by(cyl, schluckspecht = mpg) %>% 
  summarise(ps_mw = round(mean(hp)),
            ps_sd = round(sd(hp)))
```



Answerlist
----------
* A
* B
* C
* D




Solution
========


```{r error = TRUE, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

  select(1:2, hp) %>% 
  group_by(cyl, schluckspecht = mpg > 20) %>% 
  summarise(ps_mw = round(mean(hp)),
            ps_sd = round(sd(hp)))
```
